q: What did the Reformation in Denmark in 1536 involve?

options.t: The transition from Catholic to Protestant Christianity
Abolition of the king's exclusive right to trade with foreign countries

answerText: The transition from Catholic to Protestant Christianity
appeared: It appeared in the May 2025 exam.

da.q: Hvad indebar reformationen i Danmark i 1536?
options: Overgangen fra katolsk til protestantisk kristendom
Ophævelse af kongens eneret på at handle med udlandet
da.answer: Overgangen fra katolsk til protestantisk kristendom

learn.text: Under the leadership of Christian the Third, who reigned from fifteen thirty-six to fifty-nine, the Protestants won in 1536. The same year, the Reformation was formally carried out. Denmark became a Protestant country, and the king removed the Catholic bishops.
